instruction: parse_line() in csv_line.py splits a CSV line on every comma, so a quoted field containing a comma (\"Doe, Jane\") is broken into two fields. Fix parse_line() to honour double-quoted fields (a comma inside quotes is part of the field, and the surrounding quotes are removed) without breaking the existing tests in tests/test_csv_line.py. Do not use the csv module — the point of this module is to have no dependency on it.
